title: MusicDrop v1.7.4 — True YouTube on TV UI & Native ExoPlayer Video Engine
changelog:
• YouTube on Android TV UI: Faithful recreation matching official YouTube on TV reference with collapsible navigation rail
• Cinema-Scale 16:9 Widescreen Cards: Large 330x186dp video cards with high-contrast white focus outline border, titles, and duration badges
• YouTube TV In-Player HUD: Complete player overhaul with solid white circular Play/Pause button, seekbar, and quick mode toggle
• In-Player Up Next Carousel: Seamless horizontal carousel of recommended tracks directly beneath playback controls
• Direct ExoPlayer Video Streaming: Fixed stream detection so 1080p/720p hardware-accelerated video plays natively with zero blank screens
